rules.source_event_identity: source track/channel, source note-on message index, start/end tick, source pitch
rules.D1: exact source pitch/time/velocity/events; original MIDI byte copy; timbre assignment is in plan only
rules.D2: local melodic-backbone modalization only: same orchestration as D1; selected Chinese-timbre backbone notes may move +/-1 semitone; no octave displacement; not whole-song pentatonic conversion
rules.protected: all drums and bass, retained guitar/piano/aux; source note identities and timing; near-simultaneous retained octave/fifth skeleton within 1/12 quarter note; no newly introduced semitone class against any overlapping retained guitar/piano/bass note
rules.mode_caveat: Target collection/mode labels are arrangement decisions, not established original tonality or a claim of Chinese musical authenticity
rules.aux_source_caveat: Automatic transcription and existing role classifications remain uncorrected
rules.render: Use events and instrument_family; source MIDI channels do not encode the split timbres
